10 September 2026

Monetary policy decisions

The Governing Council today decided to raise the three key ECB interest rates by 50 basis points.

Key ECB interest rates

Accordingly, the interest rates on the deposit facility, the main refinancing operations and the marginal lending facility will be increased to 2.00%, 2.50% and 2.75% respectively, with effect from 1 October 2026.

European Central Bank, 2026
